We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 324324) to the given molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1). The prior step 'make_7_lvl1-template_search-1' gave mapped_rxn and template_id. So we need to apply that template to the molecule to get precursors.

We have tool apply_template. Input: molecule_smiles and template_id. Let's call it.
